{{Quote|Now you tell that armored freak that I expected to be paid for this, got it?|Mattias Ve'Shra|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Mattias Ve'Shra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was eventually ordered to be killed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommonerHumanMale.png|thumb|250px|Possible depictions of Mattias Ve'Shra, when he spawned under the "commoner_human_male" template for Darth Vader's fourth quest]]
[[File:TemplateThug.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Mattias Ve'Shra, when he spawned under the "assassin" template for Darth Vader's fifth quest]]
Mattias Ve'Shra appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]. Due to the nature of many older quests in the [[Star Wars video games|game]], Mattias' appearance would fluctuate each time the quest was performed, making it impossible to determine his [[canon]]ical [[Species/Legends|species]]. However, the quest dialogue indicated that he was a [[Gender/Legends|male]].
